questions.scenario: A computer repair shop receives a computer that is not turning on. The technician needs to diagnose the problem using a checklist of components.
questions.question: List two internal components that the technician should check first.
marking_criteria: Name two relevant internal components.
hints: Think about the components that are essential for the computer to start.
questions.model_answer: Power supply, Motherboard
questions.explanation: The power supply and motherboard are critical for the computer to turn on and function properly.

questions.scenario: A computer repair shop receives a computer that is not turning on. The technician needs to diagnose the problem using a checklist of components.
questions.question: Explain why the power supply is an important component to check.
marking_criteria: Describe the function of the power supply.
Explain its importance in the boot process.
hints: Stay focused on this: Explain why the power supply is an important component to check — develop the idea fully rather than listing short points. Make sure you also cover: its importance in the boot process.
questions.model_answer: The power supply converts AC power from the wall outlet into DC power that the computer's components can use. If the power supply is faulty, the computer will not receive the necessary power to turn on. It is crucial to check the power supply first because it is the primary source of power for the entire system.
questions.explanation: A faulty power supply can prevent the computer from receiving power, making it a critical component to check when diagnosing startup issues.

questions.scenario: A student is using a computer with a Windows operating system and notices that some files saved on the computer are not readable.

questions.scenario: A company is setting up a new network and needs to choose between a LAN (Local Area Network) and a WAN (Wide Area Network).
questions.question: Describe the main difference between a LAN and a WAN.
marking_criteria: Identify the main difference between LAN and WAN.
Provide a clear and concise explanation.
hints: Stay focused on this: Describe the main difference between a LAN and a WAN — develop the idea fully rather than listing short points. Make sure you also cover: Provide a clear and concise explanation.
questions.model_answer: The main difference between a LAN and a WAN is the geographical coverage. A LAN covers a small area like a single building or campus, while a WAN covers a large geographical area, connecting multiple LANs.
questions.explanation: Mention geographical coverage as the main difference between LAN and WAN.

questions.scenario: A company is setting up a new network and needs to choose between a LAN (Local Area Network) and a WAN (Wide Area Network).
questions.question: Explain why a company might choose a WAN over a LAN for its network setup.
marking_criteria: Identify a reason for choosing a WAN.
Provide a clear and concise explanation.
hints: Stay focused on this: Explain why a company might choose a WAN over a LAN for its network setup — develop the idea fully rather than listing short points. Make sure you also cover: Identify a reason for choosing a WAN.; Provide a clear and concise explanation.
questions.model_answer: A company might choose a WAN over a LAN if it needs to connect multiple locations that are geographically separated. A WAN allows for the connection of different LANs over a large area, facilitating communication and data sharing between distant locations.

questions.scenario: A classroom is setting up a new computer system for its students.
questions.question: Explain how a computer system can benefit students in their learning.
marking_criteria: Explain that computers provide access to a wide range of educational resources.
Explain that computers can facilitate interactive learning.
Explain that computers can help with research and project work.
Explain that computers can improve digital literacy skills.
hints: Consider the various ways computers can enhance the learning experience.
questions.model_answer: A computer system can benefit students in their learning by providing access to a wide range of educational resources, such as online textbooks, educational videos, and interactive learning tools. Computers can facilitate interactive learning through educational software and applications. They can also help with research and project work by providing access to online databases, reference materials, and collaboration tools. Additionally, using computers can improve students' digital literacy skills, which are essential in today's technology-driven world.
questions.explanation: Computers enhance learning by providing access to resources, facilitating interactive learning, aiding in research, and improving digital literacy skills.

questions.scenario: A school has recently installed new tablets for its students.
questions.question: State two differences between tablets and smartphones.
marking_criteria: Identify two differences
Provide a clear explanation for each
hints: Stay focused on this: State two differences between tablets and smartphones — develop the idea fully rather than listing short points. Make sure you also cover: Provide a clear explanation for each.
questions.model_answer: Two differences between tablets and smartphones are size and functionality. Tablets are larger than smartphones, providing a bigger screen for better viewing and multitasking. Additionally, tablets often come with features such as stylus support and larger battery life, making them more suitable for extended use and productivity tasks.
questions.explanation: Tablets and smartphones differ in size and functionality, with tablets offering larger screens and additional features for productivity.

questions.scenario: A school has recently installed new tablets for its students.
questions.question: Explain one advantage of using tablets over smartphones for educational purposes.
marking_criteria: Identify an advantage
Provide a detailed explanation
hints: Stay focused on this: Explain one advantage of using tablets over smartphones for educational purposes — develop the idea fully rather than listing short points. Make sure you also cover: Provide a detailed explanation.
questions.model_answer: One advantage of using tablets over smartphones for educational purposes is the larger screen size, which allows for better readability and multitasking. Tablets can display more content at once, making it easier for students to work on assignments, read textbooks, and use educational apps without the need to scroll frequently. This larger screen can also facilitate group work and collaborative learning activities.
questions.explanation: The larger screen size of tablets provides better readability and multitasking capabilities, which are beneficial for educational purposes.

questions.question: Name two differences between desktops and laptops.
marking_criteria: Identify two differences
Provide a clear explanation for each
hints: Stay focused on this: Name two differences between desktops and laptops — develop the idea fully rather than listing short points. Make sure you also cover: Provide a clear explanation for each.
questions.model_answer: Two differences between desktops and laptops are size and portability. Desktops are larger and less portable, typically requiring a desk or table for use. Laptops, on the other hand, are smaller and more portable, allowing users to work from different locations and easily transport them. Additionally, laptops often have integrated batteries, while desktops require an external power source.
questions.explanation: Desktops and laptops differ in size, portability, and power requirements, with laptops offering greater mobility.
